[[File:Great ditrigonal dodecicosidodecahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a great ditrigonal dodecicosidodecahedron]]
In [[geometry]], the '''great ditrigonal dodecicosidodecahedron''' (or '''great dodekified icosidodecahedron''') is a [[nonconvex uniform polyhedron]], indexed as U<sub>42</sub>. It has 44 faces (20 [[triangle]]s, 12 [[pentagon]]s, and 12 [[Decagram (geometry)|decagrams]]), 120 edges, and 60 vertices.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathconsult.ch/static/unipoly/42.html|title=42: great ditrigonal dodecicosidodecahedron|last=Maeder|first=Roman|date=|website=MathConsult|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref> Its vertex figure is an [[isosceles trapezoid]].

== Related polyhedra ==

It shares its [[vertex arrangement]] with the [[truncated dodecahedron]]. It additionally shares its [[edge arrangement]] with the [[great icosicosidodecahedron]] (having the triangular and pentagonal faces in common) and the [[great dodecicosahedron]] (having the decagrammic faces in common).
